result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs exactly the same code as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. It compiles (`mvn -o -pl cli compile`), but I didn't run it or any tests.

- **`Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. The no-argument usage overview now lists `analyzeLandscape`, using the existing landscape options.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: the dispatch accepts either name. `-help` prints the usage of the name you typed, so `analyzeLandscape -help` shows the new description and `updateLandscape -help` is unchanged.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions at all, so I added a short "Command line" section. It documents `analyzeLandscape` and says `updateLandscape` is the older name and behaves identically.
